title: Biomimetic trilayered silk-based electrospun scaffolds for regeneration of dura mater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17649-17664
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00986C, Paper
Open Access

Maryam Shafiq, Sadia Habib, Hafsah Akhtar, Saamia Naz, Mustafa Özgür Öteyaka, Asma Tufail Shah, Fahad Hussain Alhamoudi, Aqif Anwar Chaudhry, Hamad Khalid, Ather Farooq Khan
A novel biomimetic trilayered silk-based scaffold (TLS) has been fabricated using electrospinning, replicating the hierarchical structure of dura mater with remarkable physicochemical and biological properties.
